name: Implicit Neural Representation (INR) for Tomography
aliases: Implicit Neural Representation (INR) for Electron Tomography
definition: A method that uses an implicit neural network to represent the 3D volume density field, optimizing the network parameters to fit the 2D projection images while jointly optimizing the 3D orientation (pose) of each projection.
summary: Implicit Neural Representation for Tomography reconstructs 3D volumes using continuous neural networks instead of discrete grids, enabling arbitrary sampling and robustness to missing data.
